authority: Same-study cross-cohort direction robustness with different age, sex, sequencing chemistry and cluster collapses. Mean direction is reported separately from animal consistency; no exact replication or independent-study claim.
scope_limits: The observed contrast bundles doxycycline exposure with OSKM induction. BL6 doxycycline-only controls are absent from these processed objects, so drug and construct effects cannot be separated.
CPM and median-ratio agreement checks sensitivity to these size-factor choices; it does not establish absolute RNA changes or eliminate compositional effects.
Animal-level destructive snapshots and small animal counts support descriptive marker-score comparisons; they do not establish rejuvenation, function, recovery, retinal efficacy or safety.
Cohort1 birth-date tokens differ by condition; this does not establish litter membership.
